project_type: Static HTML single-page product landing page
build_system: None - static HTML file, no build step required
test_framework: None - manual visual inspection and HTML validation
test_command: python3 -c "import html.parser; p=html.parser.HTMLParser(); f=open('/projects/sandbox/Project-mission/index.html','r'); content=f.read(); print('HTML file size:', len(content), 'bytes'); print('OK' if '</html>' in content else 'INCOMPLETE')"
verification_instructions: 1. Verify index.html exists and is valid HTML. 2. Check file is not truncated (contains closing </html> tag). 3. Verify WA link has correct number and message text. 4. Verify all tabs are present and have content.
setup_instructions: No setup needed - this is a static HTML file project
environment_constraints: INTEGRATIONS_ONLY network - cannot install packages. Cannot install openpyxl or other xlsx readers. Must use zipfile+xml.etree for xlsx parsing if needed. Python3.11 with standard library is available. Node.js v22 available for validation.
contribution_requirements: Output must be a single index.html file following the same design language as index (17).html reference template
key_patterns: Reference template uses: single-file HTML with inline CSS and JS, sticky WA banner at top, tab-based navigation, cards with green Manulife branding (#00a758, #006838), FAQ accordion, responsive design, floating WA button, plan cards grid for calculator
